measurements.name: background_lock
measurements.notes: The candidate uses a stable clean plate but not exact source-background pixels.

measurements.name: human_residual_absence
measurements.notes: The source person is not composited directly, but restored flower masks still need a full-frame human-remnant audit.

measurements.name: robot_morphology
measurements.notes: One explicit MuJoCo mesh and attached hands remain complete across all 660 decoded frames.

measurements.name: robot_identity
measurements.notes: The same pinned G1 and Sharpa meshes/materials render every frame without generative identity drift.

measurements.name: embodied_motion
measurements.notes: Only 62.5% of rendered wrist observations fall within 35 source pixels; the two sides score 35.3% and 89.7%.

measurements.name: flower_integrity
measurements.notes: A tracked union is preserved, but held-instance identity and deformation are not independently verified.

measurements.name: hand_flower_contact
measurements.notes: Conditional union-mask proximity is 90.9%, but the metric cannot identify the held flower and therefore cannot prove grasp continuity.

measurements.name: occlusion_order
measurements.notes: All flower pixels are composited in front of the robot instead of using per-contact depth order.

measurements.name: temporal_consistency
measurements.notes: The output decodes fully, but no all-frame limb/contact temporal acceptance score has been persisted.

measurements.name: full_video_human_preference
measurements.notes: The new v5 candidate has not passed a blind complete-video preference review.
